summary: Allocates and initializes a render buffer with a vertex array. Runs the SEH setup, calls the base DirectX texture creation with a descriptor pointer read from *(this+0x8), computes a vertex count rounded up to even minus an even-masked base count, installs the vtable off_5ADBB8, zeroes several fields, allocates a 16-byte-stride array of that size via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes each element through sub_5008C2 with sub_5007EC as element constructor, and finally branches on the format tag at *(*(this+0x8)+4): the value 1498831189 (0x59565955) selects one 8-vs-zero field layout, otherwise the mirrored one. Returns the buffer pointer.

operations.description: Initialize the exception-handling context via SEHHandlerInit.
Load the parent descriptor pointer from *(this+0x8) into v9 and pass it, with size 0 and count 1, to DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain along with the object pointer.
Compute v4 = this[1036] & 0xFFFFFFFE, v5 = ((this[1038]+1) & 0xFFFFFFFE) - v4, store this[1054] = (this[1038]+1) & 0xFFFFFFFE and this[1052] = v4.

Install the vtable by writing &off_5ADBB8 into the object's first dword, zero the fields this[1053], this[1056], this[1055], this[1057] and this[1059], store v5 into this[1058], and set this[1060] = 1.
Allocate the vertex array through OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16 * v5), storing the result into the local at a1-16.

When the allocation result is non-null, call sub_5008C2(alloc, 16, v5, sub_5007EC) to construct v5 elements with stride 16 using sub_5007EC as the element initializer; otherwise treat the array as null.
Store the allocation result into this[1051]; if it is null, clear this[1060] back to 0.0.
Compare the format tag *(*(this+0x8)+4) with 1498831189 (0x59565955): on equality set this[1061]=8 and this[1062]=0.0; otherwise set this[1061]=0.0 and this[1062]=8.
Return the initialized buffer pointer (the object pointer).
